svg.title: Check access at each execution route
svg.desc: An agent sends requests and receives information along three distinct routes. A command runs inside a configured sandbox with specified project access. A separate pueue background service starts queued jobs under the service's own access controls. A connected online service provides records through account permissions. Built-in file tools have separate checks. The sandbox shown does not imply that it encloses the other routes.
svg.text: Check access where the work actually runs
Tool actions can take different routes
Sandbox restrictions apply to this command
Check the service and the jobs it starts
Check account permissions and returned data
Built-in file tools have separate permission checks
